args.title: Brightline: Retail Returns Logistics (combined summary)
args.body:
- Return rates for apparel have reached 24%, so returns are a big cost for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth.
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days keeps most of the margin, so speed matters.

Sources: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns ; https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion
